name: 'Test MATLAB-based tutorials'

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * WED"
      timezone: "Europe/Berlin"
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '**/*matlab/**'

jobs:
  test-matlab:
    name: Test MATLAB-based tutorials
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: precice/precice:nightly
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the tutorials repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          apt-get -qq update
          apt-get -qq install wget
          rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
      - name: Set up MATLAB
        uses: matlab-actions/setup-matlab@v3
        with: 
          release: R2024a
      - name: Get the matlab-bindings repository
        run: |
          git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/precice/matlab-bindings.git
          cd matlab-bindings && git status
      - name: Run compilation script
        uses: matlab-actions/run-command@v3
        with:
          command: "addpath('matlab-bindings'), compile_matlab_bindings_for_precice"
      - name: Get run-matlab-command
        run: |
          wget -O /usr/local/bin/run-matlab-command https://ssd.mathworks.com/supportfiles/ci/run-matlab-command/v2/glnxa64/run-matlab-command
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/run-matlab-command
      - name: Run resonant-circuit
        working-directory: resonant-circuit
        env:
          LD_PRELOAD: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6:/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libgfortran.so.5
        run: |
          sed -i 's%</participant>%<export:vtu directory=\"../precice-exports\" /> </participant>%g' precice-config.xml &&
          cd coil-matlab/ && run-matlab-command "addpath('../../matlab-bindings'), coil" &
          cd capacitor-matlab/ && run-matlab-command "addpath('../../matlab-bindings'), capacitor"
      - name: Archive logs
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: test-matlab-logs
          path: |
            resonant-circuit/*.log
            resonant-circuit/*/*.log
            resonant-circuit/capacitor-matlab/Curves.png
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Archive exports
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: test-matlab-exports
          path: |
            resonant-circuit/precice-exports/*
          if-no-files-found: warn

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
